notes: v0.71.5 — session-affinity rotation + field diagnostics, built by CI run 38396922569 from main at 7380d3c. THE ROOT CAUSE of the operator's mobile-only failure was found on 2026-10-13: the app persisted ONE x-session-id per install and the platform edge pins routing affinity by it — the install kept sending the same id for weeks across backend resurrections, so every send was pinned to a dead upstream: the app connected, got a 2xx, and received zero bytes (the exact 'connection dropped mid-turn, nothing arrived' notice), while the SAME phone's browser (fresh session id per page load, no x-session-id header) chatted fine against the same origin, and every server-side probe (fresh curl sims incl. okhttp-UA/HTTP-1.1/SSE) passed. Fix: fresh session id minted EVERY app launch (SessionStore.rotateClientId), the shared client now reads the id at request time via a provider (gsHttpClient provider overload — no client rebuild needed), and the repository auto-rotates the id whenever a send proves the pin dead (GenuineUnreachable, mid-turn cut with zero accumulated bytes, BackendError with status 0). Field diagnostics: every send-failure notice now stamps the exact build (name/versionCode), the root-cause exception (deepest cause in the Ktor wrapping chain) and the target origin, so a failure screenshot is a complete transport diagnosis. First CI attempt (run 38396262227) failed compileDebugKotlin: gsHttpClient provider call used a trailing lambda which binds to the LAST parameter (engine), not the function-type first param — fixed with explicit parens, commit 7380d3c. Server handshake aligned 0.71.4 -> 0.71.5 (turn-executor.ts + diagnostics route).
knownLimitations: OpenRouter keypool: restored 2026-10-12 with 28 live operator-provisioned keys (8 of the 36 supplied keys are revoked, 401, and were excluded). Routing verified live on openrouter/gs-swift.

backend availability depends on the sandbox dev server being alive; a dead server manifests as instant HTML 502 on sends. v0.71.5's per-launch session rotation means the app self-heals its edge routing after any backend restart.

real-device time-to-first-token is estimated, not measured; the arm64 phone run has not happened yet. The 2026-10-13 mobile-only failure was root-caused to stale session-affinity pinning (see notes), NOT the phone's network, VPN or carrier.
stable-diffusion is disabled on mobile; libgs_sd.so is not shipped.
Tesseract OCR is not in the APK; ML Kit is used instead.
